title: CMS 1500
description: This robust healthcare billing solution facilitates the seamless electronic transmission of medical claims using the standard 837P format. The platform integrates comprehensive support for the CMS-1500 standard, ensuring strict compliance for paper-based claim submissions to Medicare Fee-For-Service contractors. Engineered for precision and data security, the system streamlines the complex claims lifecycle for healthcare professionals and medical suppliers. By automating validation and processing workflows, the application significantly reduces billing errors and accelerates revenue cycles within the highly regulated US healthcare sector.

title: Medallion Karate
description: A dynamic, mobile-first web application architected for a premier martial arts academy. This streamlined single-page site combines a high-resolution visual gallery with automated mail server integration, delivering a polished user interface and centralized communication hub for real-time academy updates.

title: Sales CRM
description: A comprehensive cloud-based CRM solution that helps sales teams manage leads, opportunities, customer relationships, and sales pipelines while providing real-time analytics, forecasting, and performance insights to drive business growth.

title: Ecommerce App
description: A scalable, custom e-commerce solution developed for a prominent Indian retail brand, featuring multi-category catalog management, integrated real-time logistics and courier tracking, secure payment integration including support for Cash on Delivery, and optimized multi-device responsiveness for a nationwide customer base.

title: Manamakkal
description: A matrimonial platform built for the Tamil community, enabling users worldwide to find their ideal match through detailed profiles, smart filtering, and secure, community-focused matchmaking.

title: Dojoman Event Management software
description: An exclusive event management platform for karate tournaments, enabling organizers to generate fixtures instantly and manage registration, live scoring, streaming, and payments — all in one place.

title: Healthcare billing software
description: A comprehensive billing platform for medical practices, enabling fast patient and charge entry, real-time eligibility checks, and streamlined claims reporting — built for accuracy and efficiency in healthcare revenue cycle management.

title: Task Management
description: A team collaboration and task management platform that helps businesses manage remote and in-office teams alike — tracking progress, scheduling tasks, and optimizing productivity, all in one place.

title: Healthcare CRM
description: Healthcare CRM is a comprehensive platform that provides real-time analytics combined with customizable smart reporting and dashboards. It helps healthcare organizations systematize interactions with patients and referring providers, personalize medical service promotions, and improve overall care quality and patient satisfaction. With an outcome-focused approach to managing referring provider relationships, Healthcare CRM enables providers to deliver more connected, patient-centric care.

title: HR and Payroll
description: HR and Payroll is a comprehensive human resource management platform designed to handle key HR functions such as payroll processing, salary management, and tracking of deductions, time, attendance, loans, allowances, and bonuses. With integrated project, task, and team management tools, the platform also enables organizations to monitor employee leaves, schedules, and holidays. By automating routine HR processes, the software allows employees and HR teams to focus on more strategic, value-driven work.

title: Website Design & development
description: Website Design & Development is a comprehensive service focused on creating effective, visually engaging websites that fulfill their intended purpose. Every design is crafted to convey a clear message while keeping visitors engaged and driving them to stay on the page longer. Beyond aesthetics, the development process ensures a functional, responsive, and scalable web presence, helping businesses effectively showcase their services and products to a wider audience.

title: Sport event
description: Sport Event is a comprehensive sports management software designed to streamline event administration and improve operational efficiency. It provides coaches and players with real-time access to schedules and updates through mobile event apps, anytime and anywhere. The platform simplifies administrative tasks for sports organizers, offering online registration, payment processing, and financial management, along with performance tracking, tournament management, and detailed reporting — all from a single, centralized dashboard.

title: Real Estate
description: Real Estate CRM is a comprehensive software solution designed to manage relationships between buyers, sellers, agents, brokers, developers, and financial institutions. It caters to the multifaceted needs of real estate agents and firms, handling everything from incoming inquiries and price quotations to commercial property sales and property management. By streamlining end-to-end process management, the platform enables real estate agencies to operate more efficiently and deliver a seamless experience to their clients.

title: Performance Management System
description: Performance Management System is a corporate management platform that helps employees and managers set goals and track progress using shared, real-time tracking tools. The system enables organizations to monitor project deadlines, backlogs, and task completion while providing clear visibility into individual and team performance. With integrated dashboards for earnings, invoices, and task scheduling, the platform supports managers in evaluating employee work and driving organizational success.

title: Restaurant Management
description: A comprehensive restaurant management platform designed to streamline daily operations and enhance business efficiency. It enables restaurants to manage orders, staff, menus, offers, and customer interactions through a centralized system. Real-time dashboards provide actionable insights into sales, activities, and overall performance.

title: WorkPlace Safety App
description: This comprehensive facility management application is engineered to streamline workplace safety and daily operations. The platform offers a robust suite of integrated features, including core modules for digital inspections, incident reporting, regular audits, asset tracking, and event management. Designed to maximize operational efficiency and ensure rapid emergency response, the solution also incorporates critical push notifications for secure evacuations, QR code scanning for seamless attendance tracking, dynamic work order reporting, and centralized calendar management with seamless report sharing capabilities.

title: Taxation App
description: An end-to-end digital taxation solution for the US market, prioritizing compliance and efficiency through integrated secure multi-channel document capture and fully compliant in-app e-signature validation. The platform provides streamlined backend processing to automate return delivery to a secure customer portal and facilitate seamless professional fee collection via an integrated payment gateway.

title: Mytasky App
description: Designed with an intuitive, user-friendly interface, My Tasky minimizes onboarding time and allows teams to become productive within minutes of deployment — making it an efficient tool for organizations seeking a reliable, no-friction approach to task management.

title: Visitors management app
description: Manual visitor logs slow down front desks and compromise security — Smart Visit solves this with a secure, digital check-in system. Supporting both new and existing visitors, the app streamlines guest registration, strengthens security, and helps organizations deliver a more efficient, professional front desk experience.

title: Doctor Appointment
description: Doctor Appointment is a mobile-optimized scheduling application designed to simplify the way patients book and manage medical appointments. It allows patients to search and select specialists, view doctor profiles, and book appointments in just a few taps. On the provider side, doctors can access reception details and appointment schedules through a single, unified calendar, making the entire process more organized and efficient for both patients and healthcare staff.

title: Smart Fitness
description: Smart Fitness is a comprehensive fitness application designed to help users track their workouts and meals, measure progress, and achieve their fitness goals with the support of a personal trainer. The app offers a variety of workout types with adjustable difficulty levels, ranging from beginner to advanced, providing users with clear instructions and examples across exercise routines, physical activities, and nutritional programs to support a well-rounded fitness journey.

title: Ticket Booking
description: Ticket Booking is an online movie ticket booking platform designed to give customers a convenient way to book tickets and explore information about movies and theaters. After registering on the platform, users can browse movie listings, select their preferred showtime, and choose seats through an interactive seating layout. The booking process is completed seamlessly with a secure payment gateway integration, ensuring a smooth end-to-end ticketing experience.

title: Food delivery
description: This comprehensive online ordering management software is tailored for independent restaurants, coffee shops, quick-service chains, and fast-casual eateries alike. It acts as a versatile food delivery manager, enabling establishments to easily publish and update menus across multiple delivery platforms and locations. The system seamlessly integrates delivery operations to register all online transactions directly at your point of sale. By automating these vital workflows, it ensures your business remains fully compliant with regulations without any manual effort.

title: FINTECHESH
description: FINTECHESH is an advanced financial automation platform designed to consolidate, streamline, and modernise enterprise accounting operations. The application empowers organizations with real-time data tracking capabilities to monitor cash flow and metrics accurately. By automating critical reporting workflows, it instantly generates comprehensive financial statements with minimal manual intervention. Ultimately, it eliminates administrative overhead to deliver a seamless and stress-free invoicing experience.
